programs.title: What Is Not Automatic
programs.pins: The compiler releases nothing at scope exit: `banish` frees now and `defer banish` schedules it (LIFO); a returned value belongs to the caller, and banishing a literal is a safe no-op (`is_owned == 0`).

programs.title: Containers: `memcpy` on Store, Explicit Release
programs.pins: `push`/`put` copy the element bytes with `memcpy` and never clone a heap payload, so the store and the source alias one buffer — you release it once, by hand; a container only frees its own buffer.
